thread:
sasha: Quick async standup — kernel / batching / KV perf

what I did: landed microbatch slot allocator fix in `kernel/slotting` (PR #462). ran a perf sweep on 2x A100 hosts — ~7% p95 improvement for 512-token gen.

blockers: reproducing a KV eviction noise under spikes >8k qps. looks like slot steal during GC; reproducer with loadgen attached.

today: add instrumentation to eviction path, emit a `kv.slot_steal` metric, and open a hotpatch backport. pinging @maria for CR.

devon: saw the PR, nice. left a tiny comment about doing the atomic swap with `compare_exchange`. can you add a unit for `slot_refcount`?

maria: will review tonight. for the eviction repro — do you have heap/profile + a short timeline (burst vs sustained)?

sasha: repro is bursty (3 spikes in 30s). attaching a minimal log snippet:

```
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] qps=8200 active_slots=1320 evict_candidates=48
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] slot_steal=1 src=gc worker=slot_manager
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] qps=4300 active_slots=1298
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] reclaimed=12 latency_p95=46ms
```

lee: fyi perf-bot posted the daily bench earlier — looks like microbatch helped overall.

perf-bot: daily-bench: model=gpt-small seq=512 batch=16 p95=43ms (-3ms vs yesterday), p50=9ms. test-id=20260319-evict-sweep

devon: can we backport the atomic swap to canary once tests pass? would reduce window for races.

sasha: yes — plan: land telemetry + unit, then backport. I'll open the backport PR after metrics land.

maria: heads-up: infra scheduled a burst-cap test tomorrow 09:00 PST. would be good to have your repro and the canary ready. I can review the backport first thing.

lee: I can join the burst run and collect flamegraphs. :thumbsup:

devon: small suggestion — have the kernel telemetry emit `kv.slot_steal` as a tracing tag so we can correlate with traces.

sasha: good call, adding tracing tag and metric. ETA EOD.

maria: great. keep updates short here — post PR numbers when ready.

sasha: will do. thanks all. :raised_hands:
